# CoreMedia

<!-- generated:header (isim/tools/coverage-summary.py; do not edit by hand) -->
**Symbols:** 24.7% of Apple's iOS API (591 of 2394, exact) · **Rows:** 11: 7 ✅ 1 🟡 3 ❌ · **iOS:** 4.0+
<!-- /generated:header -->

**Area:** [Media](../COVERAGE.md#media) · **Apple:** [CoreMedia](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/coremedia) · **Issues:** [`area:media`](https://github.com/kolabs-dev/isim/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Aarea%3Amedia)

## How isim implements it

- **Adapted:** a Swift overlay plus a C API for times, time ranges and mappings (`isim/frameworks/CoreMedia/CMTime.c`, `CMTimeRange.c`) and for
  simple and buffer queues (the Swift queues' own objects: `swift/overlays/CoreMedia/Queues.swift`, `CMBufferQueue.m`). Clocks are the host's
  monotonic clock. Sample buffers and format descriptions have no C interface yet.

## API

| API / feature | Status | iOS | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CMTime`, `CMTimeRange` (CoreMedia) | ✅ | ≤17 | arithmetic, comparison, conversion, `NSValue(time:)` |
| `CMTimeRange` and `CMTimeMapping` functions (`CMTimeRangeContainsTimeRange`, `CMTimeMapTimeFromRangeToRange`, `CMTimeFoldIntoRange`, `CMTimeMappingMake`, `MakeEmpty`, `…CopyAsDictionary`, `…MakeFromDictionary`, `…CopyDescription`, `…Show`, `CMTIMERANGE_IS_…`, `CMTIME_IS_…`) | ✅ | ≤17 | Swift and C (`CMTimeRange.h`); adapted: the descriptions are isim's text (`{1/30 = 0.033}`); tested (CoreMediaTest, CoreMediaCTest: `test_coremedia.py`) |
| `CMSimpleQueue` | ✅ | ≤17 | a locked fixed-capacity FIFO; the C functions and the iOS 13 Swift API (`init(capacity:)`, `enqueue`, `dequeue`, `fullness`, `Error`) work on the same object; `CFGetTypeID`; tested (CoreMediaTest, CoreMediaCTest) |
| `CMBufferQueue`, `CMBufferCallbacks` | ✅ | ≤17 | ordering by the compare callback, timestamps (min / max / first / end PTS, DTS), duration, total size, data readiness (and `dataBecameReadyNotification`), end of data, triggers (callbacks and handlers; fire when a condition becomes true), validation, `CMBufferQueueCopyHead`, the sample-buffer callbacks and `Handlers` (`.unsortedSampleBuffers`, `.outputPTSSortedSampleBuffers`), the iOS 13 Swift API; C: callbacks and blocks (`CMBufferHandlers`), not the sample-buffer callbacks. Adapted: Swift's buffer callbacks are closures (isim's `CMTime` is a Swift struct), and `CMBufferQueueCreateWithHandlers` takes a pointer to a `CMBufferQueue.Handlers`; tested (CoreMediaTest, CoreMediaCTest) |
| `CMSampleBufferCreateCopy`, `CMSampleBufferCreateCopyWithNewTiming` | ✅ | ≤17 | the copy shares the data and format and copies the attachments; new timing per sample or for all; tested (CoreMediaTest) |
| Video format descriptions: `CMVideoFormatDescriptionGetCleanAperture`, `GetPresentationDimensions`, `MatchesImageBuffer`, `GetExtensionKeysCommonWithImageBuffers`, the big-endian image descriptions (`CMImageDescriptionFlavor`, `CMSwap…ImageDescription…`) | ✅ | ≤17 | clean aperture and pixel aspect ratio from the extensions; a format made from an image buffer takes its shared attachments; image descriptions carry the codec, size, name, depth and extension atoms (`avcC`, `hvcC`, `pasp`, `clap`, …) and keep `VerbatimImageDescription` (adapted: no other QuickTime fields); tested (CoreMediaTest) |
| `CMClock`, `CMTimebase`, `CMSync…` (CoreMedia) | ✅ | ≤17 | the host time clock (monotonic, shared with capture timestamps and `CACurrentMediaTime`); timebases on clocks or timebases with rates, anchors, timers and notifications; audio clocks follow the host clock (adapted: no drifting hardware clock); `AVCaptureSession.synchronizationClock`, `AVPlayerItem.timebase`; tested (HelloAssets: a timer at timebase time 0.6 fires after 0.3 s at rate 2) |
| `CMSampleBuffer`, `CMFormatDescription`, `CMBlockBuffer`, CoreVideo `CVPixelBuffer` (+ pools) | 🟡 | ≤17 | a sample buffer holds a decoded frame (CVPixelBuffer in main memory: BGRA/ARGB/RGBA/24RGB, one-component 8/16/half/float, depth and disparity, 14-bit Bayer, 420v/420f), interleaved PCM, or compressed samples (sizes, timing, sample attachments; format descriptions with codec configuration atoms, H.264 / HEVC parameter sets, magic cookies); block buffers own copies of the memory they are given (adapted); attachments; tested through capture, reader and writer (HelloCapture, HelloAssets). No IOSurface; Metal texture caches belong to Metal (not in isim). Missing: `CVBuffer` attachments, `CVPixelBufferCreateWithPlanarBytes`, texture caches, IOSurface; no C interface for CoreVideo |
| Types not yet in isim (iOS 17 and earlier) | ❌ | ≤17 | not implemented, found by the 2026-10 sweep: `CMAttachmentBearerProtocol`, `CMBlockBufferCustomBlockSource`, `CMBlockBufferProtocol`, `CMClosedCaptionDescriptionFlavor`, `CMMemoryPool`, `CMMetadataDescriptionFlavor`, `CMPackingType`, `CMProjectionType`, `CMSoundDescriptionFlavor`, `CMStereoViewComponents`, `CMStereoViewInterpretationOptions`, `CMSyncProtocol`, `CMTag`, `CMTaggedBuffer`, `CMTextDescriptionFlavor`, `CMTimeCodeDescriptionFlavor`, `CMTypedTag` (17 types; with their members under "Not yet in isim") |
| Types not yet in isim (iOS 26) | ❌ | 26.0 | not implemented, found by the 2026-10 sweep: `CMMutableDataBlockBuffer`, `CMReadOnlyDataBlockBuffer`, `CMReadySampleBuffer`, `CMSampleDataReference`, `CMTaggedDynamicBuffer` (5 types; with their members under "Not yet in isim") |
| Types not yet in isim (iOS 27) | ❌ | 27.0 | not implemented, found by the 2026-10 sweep: `CMBlockBufferAttachmentKeyDefinitions`, `CMCameraIntrinsicMatrix`, `CMCustomNotificationInfo`, `CMDroppedFrameReason`, `CMSampleBufferAttachmentKeyDefinitions`, `CMStillImageLensStabilization` (6 types; with their members under "Not yet in isim") |
